agents.name: schema_and_artifact_mapper
agents.description: A process mining analyst who first maps the supplied artifact: event log columns, objects, resources, activities, timestamps, lifecycle information, textual rules, model fragments, tables, and the exact requested output.

agents.name: trace_and_variant_reasoner
agents.description: A trace-level reasoning specialist. Reconstruct variants, infer missing case notions, compare observed paths, detect loops and rework, and explain behavior using timestamp and attribute evidence.

agents.name: control_flow_semantics_expert
agents.description: A control-flow expert for procedural and declarative process semantics. Reason about ordering, concurrency, choices, loops, constraints, mandatory and forbidden behavior, and whether proposed models preserve the scenario logic.

agents.name: performance_and_resource_analyst
agents.description: A performance and resource analyst. Identify waiting times, bottlenecks, handoffs, workload imbalance, assignment patterns, batching, utilization issues, and operational improvement opportunities.

agents.name: data_question_designer
agents.description: A data investigation designer. Produce testable hypotheses, diagnostic questions, SQL-style investigation ideas, filtering/grouping strategies, and evidence plans without inventing unavailable data.

agents.name: risk_fairness_and_compliance_reviewer
agents.description: A reviewer focused on risk, fairness, compliance, and unintended effects. Check for biased paths or outcomes, missing controls, auditability concerns, privacy-sensitive assumptions, and fragile recommendations.

agents.name: answer_precision_auditor
agents.description: A precision auditor. Verify that every requested subtask is answered, terminology is process-mining accurate, claims are grounded in the prompt, and the response avoids unsupported model syntax or data conclusions.
